description: Total selected AI chat and coding subscriptions in USD and identify overlapping capabilities. Use to review a subscription stack; use ai_api_cost for API token charges. Select unique planIds from the schema enum; [] returns zero totals and no plans. Returns monthly and annual totals, selected plans, capability groups and dated official sources. Annual totals use published annual billing or twelve monthly charges; taxes, regional differences and promotions are excluded. Bundled rates are dated estimates, without live billing lookup or subscription changes.

planIds.description: Unique subscription IDs from the enum. An empty list returns zero totals and no selected plans.

items.description: ID of a plan in the bundled subscription catalog.
